title: Before you arrive
intro: A short reading list for the weeks before university starts. It covers the nerves, the unknowns and the new language, so you can arrive a little steadier.

title: Back at university
intro: A short reading list for the days before a new term at a university you already know. It covers looking back at last year, easing back into your studies, and the friendships that may have changed over the break.

title: When you can't switch off
intro: A short reading list for the nights and weeks when your body is tired but your mind keeps running. It covers what stress does, why sleep and mood pull on each other, and small ways to ease both.
